groups.name: Ledger query filtering to stop rescanning every monthly ledger
groups.rationale: Adds `kind`, `repo`, and `rounds` filters to LedgerQuery so `sessionAnnotations()` can ask the store for only matching records, skipping entire month files and unparseable lines via substring gates before parsing.
groups.watch: The substring gate in `lineMayMatch` must not reject lines that actually match—false positives are acceptable and get caught by `recordMatches`, but false negatives would silently drop results. The month file filter must not skip a month containing late records within the `since` window.

groups.name: Documentation of the fix in backlog
groups.rationale: Marks the item done, notes the performance improvement from 185ms to 22ms on a 50k-record ledger, and clarifies that `corrupt` now counts only lines the query examined while `stats()` remains the full count.
groups.watch: The claim that `prune` needs no index and that filtered reads still have one source of truth should hold true against the implementation in the ledger module.

groups.name: Documentation artifacts for related design decisions
groups.rationale: Six new HTML documents explaining the focus model, file approval state, draft preservation on SSE updates, two-round proof-of-concept screenshots, and UI badge choices—all supporting context for the broader change to multi-round reviews.
groups.watch: These are documentation and design notes, not executable code. Verify that the decisions they describe are actually reflected in the implementation—for instance, that `approval` terminology is used consistently if the focus-model document recommends it over `focus`.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
